problems.prompt: A ³He tube detects neutrons primarily via:
problems.explain: Neutrons are neutral; capture produces ionizing charged particles.

problems.prompt: BF₃ tubes use the capture reaction ¹⁰B(n,____)⁷Li.
problems.explain: ¹⁰B(n,α)⁷Li releases charged products detected in the gas.

problems.prompt: Thermal neutrons vs fast neutrons in these gas counters:
problems.explain: Capture cross-sections peak at thermal energies; moderators help fast beams.

problems.prompt: “Wall effect” in a proportional counter refers to:
choices: partial energy deposit when products hit the wall
problems.explain: Charged products that strike the wall deposit less than Q → continuum below the peak.
